newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bank drains 60 million dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bank drains 60 million dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's bank al-Maghrib (central bank) drained 60 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.

The bank received bids totalling 3.290 billion dirhams and allocated 2.500 billion dirhams at a seven-percent interest rate. That was less than the 2.560 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the bank said.
It satisfied 75.98 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is on October 30, 1996, he added.
